ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels estimated at 85-90% coverage with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in circular clusters representing 10-15% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark charcoal pigmentation across the entire visible field with approximately 60-80 discrete circular white blobs ranging from 3 to 12 pixels in diameter distributed irregularly across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured interior angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 2-5 pixels; irregularities are more pronounced on the outer thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve tapering to pointed distal tips; leading edge trajectory is partially occluded by water-level turbulence.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacle scars) distributed across the central and distal regions of both lobes, with notable concentrations at the trailing edge margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal scarring appearing as white circular rosettes across the ventral surface, likely resulting from historic barnacle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct white pigmentation clusters at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
